subject: Split-window ML probe — timezone stitching & platform handoff
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, michael.dobbs@gmail.com
Cc: recruiting@talentbridge.co
Date: 2026-10-28 09:12 -0700
Subject: Split-window ML probe — timezone stitching & platform handoff

Hi team,

Scheduling note for Michael's ML screen next week. His timezone is PT (San Francisco). We want a split-window approach: a short systems/design discussion (30m) followed by a coding/proto session (40m) on CoderPad. The motivation is to reduce cognitive load for the candidate and let two interviewers focus independently. Proposed times (PT):

- Option A: Wed 2026-11-03 10:00–11:10 (Kimberly first, Laura second)
- Option B: Thu 2026-11-04 16:00–17:10 (Laura first, Kimberly second)

Logistics:
- Host: Zoom link (see related_links)
- Coding: CoderPad session will run in split-mode; session id in related_links.
- Ephemeral VM: for any experiment involving disk or package installs — link in related_links.
- Attachments: candidate resume and runbook attached.

Asks:
1) Kim/Laura — please confirm which option you prefer and which segments you want to own (design vs coding). If either of you has on-call conflicts at those windows, flag who can cover.
2) Michael — please confirm availability for A or B and whether you consent to recording for debrief purposes.

I will send the calendar invite once we lock the order and hosts. Small note: for the coding portion, default environment will be Python 3.11 with numpy/pandas available; if you want a different runtime, tell me now so I can pre-provision the VM.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior SRE Hiring Partner, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: michael_dobbs_resume.pdf (pdf), split-window-interview-runbook.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Split-window ML probe — timezone stitching & platform handoff

On Wed, 2026-10-28 at 09:12, jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Scheduling note for Michael's ML screen next week.

Thanks, Jonas — I can do Option A (Wed 11/03) and I'm comfortable owning the first 30m (system design + model tradeoffs). I have a recurring pager overlap from 10:30–11:00 PT on Thursdays, so Option B would be risky for me.

For the coding slot I can review the CoderPad outputs and watch for edge-case handling; happy to take notes for rubric. I don't need the ephemeral VM unless Michael wants to run heavier installs.

Two small asks:
- Can we add the prompt file to the CoderPad before the session so the candidate doesn't have to fetch assets?
- If we record, please add a short consent line in the calendar invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Principal SWE, Interviewing
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Thanks for the note. Either Option A (Wed 11/03 10:00 PT) or Option B (Thu 11/04 16:00 PT) works for me, but I prefer Option A. I consent to the recording for internal debrief only.

A couple of quick questions:
- Do I need to pre-install anything for the CoderPad? I prefer not to install extra packages.
- Will the CoderPad include the dataset used for the prompt or should I fetch it from the VM?

Thanks — looking forward to it.
